claim_results.rationale: C0000 correctly reflects U0001 defining minor applicants as un-emancipated applicants under the age of 18 for the purposes of this chapter. Scope, summary, boundary, and actor are properly aligned.

source_spans.quote: For purposes of this chapter, minor applicants are defined as un-emancipated applicants under the age of 18.

claim_results.rationale: C0003 correctly summarizes the prohibition that an applicant may not continue using a previous name after a material name change unless specifically permitted by the documentation, matching U0011.

source_spans.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).
